method: Two independent censuses (immediate-match and constant-propagation dataflow) implemented TWICE -- once in C, once here -- and compared as SETS. Counts are never compared, because the two scan methods legitimately see different addressing forms.

FINDING_0x80090BEE_IS_THE_CINEMATIC_CAME.what_it_is: the FLAGS halfword at +0x2E of the shared cinematic/setpiece camera block 0x80090BC0 -- the same block C14 (telescope) and D17 (bird) use
FINDING_0x80090BEE_IS_THE_CINEMATIC_CAME.access_width: lhu / sh (HALFWORD). An earlier pass recorded lbu/sb.
FINDING_0x80090BEE_IS_THE_CINEMATIC_CAME.bit_0x01: cinematic camera ACTIVE. Selects the camera SOURCE at 0x8004EBFC (setpiece block vs the ordinary follow camera 0x80095358), and in gameplay_state_machine makes both HUD sites call 0x80053638 (draw_mirrored_fullscreen_quads = letterboxing) instead of 0x800526F4 (hud_draw).
FINDING_0x80090BEE_IS_THE_CINEMATIC_CAME.bit_0x02: hold 0x800A6590 bit 0x04 for the duration: ORed in on entry (0x8004EB64) and cleared on exit (0x8004EBC8).
FINDING_0x80090BEE_IS_THE_CINEMATIC_CAME.why_the_value_2_is_not_a_defeat_code: both writers take the value as a CALLER-SUPPLIED argument. The resident telescope setpiece path passes 2 unconditionally (0x8004D6F4), and so do several level overlays.

FINDING_POWER_BIT_0x04_IS_A_SUPPRESSION_.shape: every one of the five branches PAST its body when the bit is set; none enables anything
FINDING_POWER_BIT_0x04_IS_A_SUPPRESSION_.gameplay_effect: taking the branch in gameplay_state_machine masks the player action word 0x80082488 down to 0x309
FINDING_POWER_BIT_0x04_IS_A_SUPPRESSION_.corrects: the earlier reading that boss defeat 'grants a previously unidentified power'

FINDING_THE_LEVEL_EXIT_IS_A_DIFFERENT_ST.overlay_identity_was_measured: region A 0x800B39A0 is a SHARED swap buffer, so an overlay address is meaningless without knowing the resident blob. This was verified live by hashing the resident window; an earlier draft of this analysis attributed the code to LEVEL03/LEVEL1.BIN and was wrong.
FINDING_THE_LEVEL_EXIT_IS_A_DIFFERENT_ST.order: camera start FIRST, goal latch SECOND, one straight-line block, same frame
FINDING_THE_LEVEL_EXIT_IS_A_DIFFERENT_ST.no_path_from_the_flags_word: the complete consumer set of 0x80090BEE (above) contains no read or write of 0x800823A0, the scene id 0x80082504, or any loader entry

census_0x80090BEE.known_blind_spot: neither scan can see an access through a pointer loaded from memory; that possibility is NOT claimed against
